title: Curious Urgency 38
author: bpatrick
body: Jonny Paycheck is calling for new Onan. Unless anyone else has any other suggestions I’m inclined to oblige him.

comments.author: Garbledina
comments.text: This is my favorite of all your stories so far. It’s simply stunning, gritty, and original. Does one person make these or what?

comments.author: Och
comments.text: I’ve started liking this one better than Vivian Blank, even. Good to see it~

comments.author: Erick
comments.text: Omg this story is so gooooooooood, just everything is just great i can’t even explain it

comments.author: whowhat
comments.text: So are you going to tell us what the fuck happened? First it seemed like you had just forgotten to rebuy your domain name or whatever, but then there were some huge douchebags’ blogs.

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.text:
Repost from the “Akimbo isn’t dead yet” post:

Haha, thanks for the comments/concern. I’ll field this question. Brian forgot to renew his domain, but the hosting is on my server (where I also have my douchebag blog) for some reason when he got everything straightened out my switch to activate Brian’s new domain (in case he couldn’t buy the old one back) apparently resulted in pointing the REAL domain to my blog. Sorry about that, all is well for now. As it turns out, the registrar Brian used is sort of difficult to deal with, he is in the process of transferring it to someone more reputable. For now think happy thoughts and try to forget about the horrors you had seen.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: I thought the site with emulsifier’s pics was sweet! Sorry again for the interruption.

comments.author: Ivarian
comments.text: Just finished catching up on the archives, just wanted to say I love your work, the art the writing, its amazing. Also, I nearly had a heart attack when your site was down thinking I’d never get to read up on what had been there. Very glad Akimbo isn’t dead. ^.^

comments.author: T52
comments.text:
So many great details in this one. Love the silhouette of the hairy ape/wolf guy on the pipes in the upper right!

Also, Curious Urgency is by far my favorite story on this site. Can we have some more, please?

comments.author: msr
comments.text: I’m a big fan of this comic. Write more now. I bet you’d have a hit if you did it on a regular schedule.
